title: Reject non-existent calendar dates in WeeklyRoundupUtils strict parsing
acceptanceCriteria: parseStandardDate("2021-02-30") returns null instead of the SMART-resolved 2021-02-28
parseWeekPeriodDate("2021W02W30") returns null instead of the SMART-resolved 2021-02-28

parseStandardDate("2023-02-29") and parseWeekPeriodDate("2023W02W29") return null for the non-leap year, while parseStandardDate("2024-02-29") and parseWeekPeriodDate("2024W02W29") return LocalDate.of(2024, 2, 29)
Day overflow in 30-day months returns null: parseStandardDate("2021-04-31"), parseStandardDate("2021-06-31"), parseWeekPeriodDate("2021W04W31"), parseWeekPeriodDate("2021W06W31")

Out-of-range month and day values stay null: parseStandardDate("2021-13-01"), parseStandardDate("2021-00-10"), parseStandardDate("2021-08-00"), parseWeekPeriodDate("2021W13W01"), parseWeekPeriodDate("2021W00W10"), parseWeekPeriodDate("2021W08W00")

Accepted valid inputs are unchanged: parseStandardDate("2021-08-10"), parseWeekPeriodDate("2021W08W10"), parseStandardDate("2021-01-01"), parseStandardDate("2021-12-31") keep their previous LocalDate values; "invalid" and the empty string still return null
The new focused regression tests are captured RED before the implementation with assertion failures caused by non-null clamped dates, not by compilation or fixture errors, and pass GREEN afterwards
The focused filter run and the standalone ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest both pass; assembleDebug passes; independent Review passes

Public signatures parseStandardDate(date: String): LocalDate? and parseWeekPeriodDate(date: String): LocalDate? are unchanged, as are the return type, the AppLog.e(T.NOTIFS, ...) rejection logging, and the WeeklyRoundupRepository null-handling call chain
nonGoals: No change to the accepted date text formats, Locale.ROOT, public signatures, or return types
No change to log content, log level, or logging channel on parse rejection
No change to WeeklyRoundupRepository.kt, WeeklyRoundupRepositoryTest.kt, or any other file in the weeklyroundup package
No ISO week-based-year semantics and no support for additional date formats
No new dependencies, no Gradle or build configuration changes, no refactors outside WeeklyRoundupUtils, no documentation changes
No new exception types, no exception propagation, and no change to the failure return contract of null
testPolicyReason: A parser behavior regression requires focused unit tests proving that non-existent calendar dates return null while valid inputs and the null return contract are preserved
